write_authority: eravors_chat_thread and eravors_chat_prefs — §10.1, the engine only. Surfaces render; they never store.
failure_modes: no storage -> constructor throws, refuses to operate blind
empty send (no text, no attachment) -> throws
over-long send -> throws, naming the 4000-char limit
unknown attachment kind -> throws, listing the known ones
attachment without an id -> throws; it is a reference, not a copy
offline send -> marked queued, kept in thread, replayed by the Phase 1 outbox
transport throw -> recorded ON the message, never swallowed
listener throws -> named in console, does not break the send
unknown event on on() -> throws, listing known events
invariants: §1.2 ephemeral types are NEVER persisted — not capped, not trimmed, never written
duplicate replay is idempotent — the outbox cannot double-post
cursor sharing and read receipts default OFF and require opt-in on THIS side
a remote cursor is ignored unless this side also opted in
stale presence expires (cursor 5s, typing 6s) rather than hanging
§10.1 two surfaces over one store cannot diverge — asserted by test
status: implemented — 36/36 in test/choice-chat.test.mjs. Phase D two-device verification is open by design.
